title: Network topology shapes consensus and vulnerability in LLM populations
title_zh: 网络拓扑塑造 LLM 群体中的共识与脆弱性

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in interacting populations, their collective behaviour depends not only on the models but also on who interacts with whom. Studies of convention formation in LLM populations have mainly tested well-mixed interactions. We place policies extracted from four LLMs on fully connected, random regular, and heterogeneous networks, with 10 3 10^{3} to 10 5 10^{5} agents playing the naming game. Topology affects how quickly consensus emerges, sometimes whether it emerges at all, and, in rare cases, which convention wins. Sparsest networks slow consensus up to twelvefold. Yet, by preserving correlations between persistent neighbours, they restore consensus in some cases that fail to converge under well-mixed interactions. Networks also govern vulnerability to adversarial attack. We measure the critical mass of committed agents needed to overturn an established convention. Tipping thresholds follow the same ordering across models and conditions: hubs ≤ \leq random ≤ \leq low-degree nodes. On the most heterogeneous topology, median critical masses are 3%, 16%, and 35%, respectively; targeting hubs requires one-sixth as many committed agents as random placement. For most models, networked populations are easier to tip than well-mixed ones, so well-mixed estimates can overstate robustness. Assessing the safety of multi-agent AI requires mapping who interacts with whom.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）被部署到相互交互的群体中，它们的集体行为不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于谁与谁交互。 关于LLM群体中惯例形成的研究主要测试的是均匀混合的交互。 我们将从四个LLM中提取的策略放置在全连接网络、随机正则网络和异构网络上，让10^{3}到10^{5}个智能体玩命名游戏。 网络拓扑影响共识出现的速度，有时影响共识是否出现，在少数情况下还会影响哪种惯例最终胜出。 最稀疏的网络会将共识的形成速度放慢至多十二倍。 然而，通过保持持久邻居之间的相关性，这些网络在某些均匀混合交互下无法收敛的情况下恢复了共识。 网络还决定了对对抗性攻击的脆弱程度。 我们测量了推翻既定惯例所需的坚定智能体的临界数量。 临界翻转阈值在所有模型和条件下遵循相同的排序：枢纽节点 ≤ \leq 随机节点 ≤ \leq 低度节点。 在最异构的拓扑上，中位临界质量分别为3%、16%和35%；针对枢纽节点所需的坚定智能体数量仅为随机放置的六分之一。 对于大多数模型而言，网络化群体比均匀混合群体更容易被翻转，因此均匀混合下的估计可能高估了鲁棒性。 评估多智能体AI的安全性需要弄清楚谁与谁交互。

paragraphs.en: AI agents are moving from isolated tools to interacting populations [ 1 , 2 ] . Multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) already operate in finance [ 3 , 4 ] , defence [ 5 ] , social media [ 6 ] , and personal assistance [ 7 ] . The collective behaviour of these populations is becoming directly observable at multiple scales. In Emergence World, a continuously running multi-agent environment, groups of dozens of agents have been observed cooperating to create and maintain shared institutions [ 8 ] . In July 2026, about 1200 1200 agents at OpenAI exchanged more than 70 000 70\,000 messages and files and coordinated collective projects to tamper with the scorer of the benchmark they were working on, resulting in a successful cyberattack on Hugging Face’s digital infrastructure [ 9 ] . On Moltbook, an agent-only social platform, hundreds of thousands of agents organise into communities with a highly hierarchical interaction structure [ 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体正从孤立的工具转变为相互交互的群体 [1, 2]。 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统已经应用于金融 [3, 4]、国防 [5]、社交媒体 [6] 和个人助理 [7] 等领域。 这些群体的集体行为正在多个尺度上变得可以直接观测。 在 Emergence World 这一持续运行的多智能体环境中，已有观察到数十个智能体组成的群体合作创建并维护共享制度 [8]。 2026 年 7 月，OpenAI 的约 1200 个智能体交换了超过 70000 条消息和文件，并协调集体项目篡改它们所工作基准的评分器，导致对 Hugging Face 数字基础设施的一次成功网络攻击 [9]。 在 Moltbook 这一仅限智能体的社交平台上，数十万个智能体组织成具有高度层级化交互结构的社区 [10, 11]。

paragraphs.en: Many interactions in these systems aim to reach agreement on conventions : shared behaviours that help achieve common goals without a central coordinating authority [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The centrality of conventions has motivated experimental work on their emergence in AI multi-agent systems, often based on minimal models that capture the core coordination mechanisms. One such model is the naming game , in which pairs of agents try to coordinate on a name [ 16 ] . Theoretical studies [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] and laboratory experiments with humans [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] have shown that, in the naming game, conventions can emerge spontaneously from repeated local interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统中的许多交互旨在就约定达成一致：约定是在没有中央协调权威的情况下帮助实现共同目标的共享行为 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 约定的核心地位推动了关于其在 AI 多智能体系统中涌现的实验研究，这些研究通常基于捕捉核心协调机制的最小模型。 其中一个模型是命名博弈，其中成对的智能体试图就一个名称达成协调 [ 16 ] 。 理论研究 [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] 和针对人类的实验室实验 [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] 已经表明，在命名博弈中，约定可以从重复的局部交互中自发涌现。

paragraphs.en: Recent simulations with populations of LLM-based agents have revealed similar patterns. AI agents playing the naming game can reach global conventions through local interactions, although these interactions can produce collective biases absent in individual agents [ 24 ] . The strength and form of these biases vary with population size in nonlinear, model-dependent ways [ 25 ] . Established conventions can also be overturned. A committed minority, a group of agents that always promote an alternative, can tip the whole population once it exceeds a critical fraction [ 26 , 21 ] . This critical mass is key to the stability of these systems because it measures a social attack surface: the number of adversarial agents needed to overturn a convention a population has already settled on [ 27 ] . Critical mass has been measured at 25 % 25\% in experiments with human groups [ 21 ] , ranges from 10 % 10\% to 40 % 40\% in theoretical models depending on their assumptions [ 26 , 28 ] , and spans 2 % 2\% to 67 % 67\% in AI populations depending on the underlying LLM [ 24 ] .

paragraphs.en: In the classical naming game, interaction structure has well-known effects. On low-dimensional lattices, consensus proceeds through the slow coarsening of local domains [ 31 ] . On heterogeneous networks, high-degree nodes act as spreaders of conventions [ 32 ] , and on sparse random networks the tipping point shifts [ 33 ] . In human experiments, a global convention emerged in homogeneously mixing populations but not on one-dimensional lattices or random networks of degree 4 4 [ 20 ] . LLM-derived policies, however, are biased, rely on bounded memory, and exhibit asymmetric critical masses and mixed states absent from the classical model [ 24 , 25 ] . To our knowledge, networked LLM populations playing the naming game have been studied only in groups of 16 16 agents [ 34 ] , and the critical mass of an LLM population has never been measured on a network.

paragraphs.en: Here, we study how network topology shapes the formation of conventions in LLM populations and their robustness to committed minorities. We use the policies extracted from four LLMs by Flint et al. [25] , which allow simulations of up to 10 5 10^{5} agents. We place them on four topologies: a fully connected network, equivalent to the well-mixed setting; two uncorrelated networks with power-law degree distributions [ 35 ] , one heterogeneous and one nearly homogeneous; and a random regular network. We find that networks change how fast consensus is reached and, for some word pairs, which convention wins and whether it is reached at all. For three of the four models, the fully connected network is the fastest and the random regular network the slowest. In two cases, the networks with the lowest mean degree also reverse which convention wins. Networks homogeneous and low average degree restore restore consensus for one of the two word pairs that fail to converge when well-mixed, requiring the presence of dynamical correlations between neighbouring agents. Hubs reach a given level of coordination earlier than low-degree nodes, spreading the consensus to the rest of the network. Yet they are the cheapest place from which to overturn a convention. In every condition we tested, the critical fraction is lowest when the committed agents occupy the hubs and highest when they occupy the low-degree nodes. Overall, our work extends the study of LLM populations from well-mixed to networked settings, and identifies the structure of interactions as a key factor in how the collective behaviour of multi-agent AI systems emerges and how it can be exposed to adversarial attack.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们研究网络拓扑如何塑造大语言模型群体中惯例的形成及其对坚定少数派的稳健性。 我们使用 Flint 等人从四个大语言模型中提取的策略。 [25]，这些策略允许对多达 10^{5} 个智能体进行模拟。 我们将它们置于四种拓扑结构上：完全连接网络，等同于充分混合设定；两个具有幂律度分布的无关联网络 [35]，一个是异质性的，一个是近乎同质性的；以及一个随机正则网络。 我们发现网络会改变达成共识的速度，并且对于某些词对，还会改变哪种惯例获胜以及能否达成共识。 在四个模型中的三个中，完全连接网络速度最快，随机正则网络最慢。 在两种情形中，平均度最低的网络还会逆转哪种惯例获胜。 同质且平均度低的网络恢复了两个词对之一在充分混合时未能收敛的共识，这需要相邻智能体之间存在动态关联。 枢纽节点比低度节点更早达到给定的协调水平，从而将共识扩散到网络的其他部分。 然而它们却是推翻惯例代价最低的位置。 在我们测试的每种条件下，当坚定智能体占据枢纽节点时，临界比例最低；当它们占据低度节点时，临界比例最高。 总体而言，我们的工作将大语言模型群体的研究从充分混合设定扩展到网络化设定，并确定交互结构是多智能体 AI 系统集体行为如何涌现以及如何暴露于对抗性攻击的关键因素。

paragraphs.en: We study the emergence of linguistic conventions using the minimal naming game, in which pairs of agents repeatedly interact and attempt to coordinate on one of W = 2 W=2 competing conventions [ 17 , 24 ] . At each interaction, an agent produces a candidate word informed by its memory of the outcomes of its H H most recent interactions. Memories are empty at the start of a simulation. When two interacting agents produce the same word, the interaction is scored as successful and both agents’ scores increase; a mismatch is scored as a failure, with the reward for success exceeding the penalty for failure. sents.en: The two rules differ in how strongly an agent’s degree determines its chance of being drawn into an interaction, and we use the comparison as a control in Section 3.1.1 .
sents.zh: 这两种规则的差别在于智能体的度在多大程度上决定其被抽入交互的概率，我们将在第 3.1.1 节中把这一比较作为对照。

sents.en: The two selection rules coincide in FC and RRN because every node has the same degree (see Appendix A1.5 ).
sents.zh: 在全连接网络（FC）和随机正则网络（RRN）中，由于每个节点的度都相同，这两种选择规则是一致的（见附录 A1.5）。

paragraphs.en: In Sections 2.3 and 3.1.3 , we use annealed networks as a control to isolate the effects of correlations in agents’ memory states caused by repeated interactions [ 38 ] . An annealed network keeps the degree of every node but rewires its edges, so that agents no longer interact persistently with the same individuals. We simulate it in the limit of infinitely fast rewiring, in which all edges are reshuffled before every interaction. In this limit the network structure, and with it every correlation of the memory states between neighbours, is lost. The only remaining property is the network degree sequence. By comparing annealed networks to the standard “quenched” (fixed) networks, we can determine whether an observed effect is driven by the correlations that build up between neighbours’ states over time.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 2.3 节和第 3.1.3 节中，我们使用退火网络作为对照，以分离由重复交互导致的智能体记忆状态中的相关性所带来的影响 [ 38 ] 。 退火网络保留每个节点的度，但重新连接其边，从而使智能体不再持续地与相同的个体交互。 我们在无限快速重连的极限情形下对其进行模拟，此时所有边在每次交互之前都会被重新洗牌。 在这种极限下，网络结构以及随之而来的邻居之间记忆状态的所有相关性都会丧失。 唯一保留的性质是网络的度序列。 通过将退火网络与标准的“淬火”（固定）网络进行比较，我们可以确定所观察到的效应是否由邻居状态之间随时间积累起来的相关性所驱动。

paragraphs.en: To probe the robustness of an established convention against a committed minority, we seed a fixed fraction p p of the population with agents that always produce one target convention and never update their state, while the remaining agents begin in the steady consensus state on the competing convention, implemented by initialising them with a full memory of agreeing interactions in that convention. For each fraction p p , we execute 200 independent runs to estimate the probability that the population flips to the committed convention within the simulation horizon, and we locate the critical fraction p ∗ p^{*} , the smallest committed fraction at which the flip probability reaches 0.5 0.5 , by bisection on the committed count to a resolution of Δ ​ p ≤ 0.01 \Delta p\leq 0.01 . Within each pair, we called strong the convention preferred by the population in FC during convergence, and weak the other. Both commitment directions are tested for every word pair. On the UCM networks we rank the nodes by their degree, and we place the committed set either at the top of the ranking, at the bottom, or at random.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究已建立的惯例面对坚定少数群体时的稳健性，我们向种群中植入固定比例 p p 的智能体，这些智能体始终产生某一目标惯例且永不更新其状态，而其余智能体则处于相互竞争的惯例上的稳态共识中，通过为它们初始化该惯例下完全一致的交互记忆来实现。 对于每个比例 p p ，我们执行 200 次独立运行来估计种群在仿真时间范围内翻转至坚定惯例的概率，并通过对坚定智能体数量进行二分查找（分辨率 Δ ​ p ≤ 0.01 \Delta p\leq 0.01 ）来定位临界比例 p ∗ p^{*} ，即翻转概率达到 0.5 0.5 的最小坚定比例。 在每一对词中，我们将收敛期间 FC 种群偏好的惯例称为强惯例，将另一个称为弱惯例。 每个词对都测试两种坚定方向。 在 UCM 网络上，我们按度对节点进行排序，并将坚定智能体集合置于排名的顶端、底端或随机位置。

paragraphs.en: To test whether topology systematically changes how fast a population reaches consensus, we compared the mode of the convergence time of every combination of word pair. We use the mode because it is less sensitive to outliers, but repeating the analysis on the mean gives the same results (Table A1 , Figure A1 ). paragraphs.en: Removing persistent neighbourhoods also changes the speed of consensus. For each of the 42 model × \times word-pair conditions in which all runs reach consensus on both networks, we compare the median convergence time on the annealed network with that on the quenched network. The annealed network is faster in 31 conditions, equally fast in 8, and slower in 3. Median convergence time on the annealed network is 14 % 14\% faster overall (median across conditions; range from 55 % 55\% faster to 27 % 27\% slower; Wilcoxon signed-rank test on log times, p = 2 × 10 − 6 p=2\times 10^{-6} ), and the reduction grows with the quenched convergence time (Spearman ρ = − 0.69 \rho=-0.69 , p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ): for the ten slowest conditions (quenched median 21 21 - 281 281 rounds), consensus time drops by 45 % 45\% . Together with the tilt, these results suggest that persistent neighbourhoods sustain local agreements that conflict with the rest of the population. This helps low-degree nodes early on but delays global consensus, and increasingly so the slower consensus already is.

paragraphs.en: In the well-mixed population, the Llama pairs {young, old} and {more, less} reach consensus at small system size N N but, above a critical size, freeze in a mixed state in which neither convention ever wins [ 25 ] . Adding network structure rescues this failure, but only for the two topologies with the most homogeneous degree distributions: UCM 5.0 and RRN (Table 2 ). The rescue is slower on UCM 5.0 , and its cost grows with N N : the median convergence time rises from 108 108 to 267 267 rounds between N = 1000 N=$1000$ and 100 000 100\,000 , against 64 64 to 79 79 on RRN (Table A3 ). No topology rescues the pair {more/less} at any size tested except RRN at N = 1000 N=1000 ( 0.10 0.10 , median 508 508 rounds), which fails at all larger sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 在均匀混合种群中，Llama 的配对 {young, old} 和 {more, less} 在较小的系统规模 N N 下能达成共识，但一旦超过临界规模，就会冻结在一种混合状态中，任何一种约定都无法胜出 [ 25 ] 。 引入网络结构可以挽救这一失败，但仅对度分布最均匀的两种拓扑有效：UCM 5.0 和 RRN（表 2 ）。 在 UCM 5.0 上挽救的速度较慢，且其代价随 N N 增长：中位收敛时间在 N = 1000 N=$1000$ 到 100 000 100\,000 之间从 108 108 轮上升到 267 267 轮，而在 RRN 上则是从 64 64 轮到 79 79 轮（表 A3 ）。 在所有测试的规模下，没有任何拓扑能挽救配对 {more/less}，唯一的例外是 RRN 在 N = 1000 N=1000 时（ 0.10 0.10 ，中位数 508 508 轮），而在所有更大的规模下均告失败。

paragraphs.en: To investigate further the cause of the rescued consensus, we run UCM 5.0 and RRN using annealed network controls, which preserve every node’s degree while removing persistent neighbourhoods. A stable pair {african/white} was run alongside as a negative control and reaches consensus in every condition, confirming the annealing itself is not the source of any failure to converge. Under annealing, both UCM 5.0 and RRN fail to rescue either mixed-state pair at any population size: the consensus fraction is exactly 0.00 0.00 for {young/old} and {more/less} on both topologies at every N ∈ { 1000 , 5000 , 10000 , 100000 } N\in\{1000,5000,10000,100000\} (300 runs per condition). For RRN this is expected: in the annealed network approximation, the dynamics on an RRN of any degree K K reduces to FC (Appendix A1 ). This shows that the rescue in networks with homogeneous degree requires the dynamical correlations between the states of neighbours.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步探究 rescued consensus 的成因，我们使用退火网络控制运行 UCM 5.0 和 RRN，这种控制在保持每个节点度数不变的同时消除持久的邻域。 同时运行一个稳定的配对 {african/white} 作为阴性对照，它在所有条件下都达成共识，这证实退火本身并非任何未能收敛的原因。 在退火条件下，无论种群规模多大，UCM 5.0 和 RRN 都无法挽救任何一个混合态配对：在两种拓扑上、在所有 N ∈ { 1000 , 5000 , 10000 , 100000 } N\in\{1000,5000,10000,100000\} 条件下，{young/old} 和 {more/less} 的共识比例均为 0.00 0.00（每种条件 300 次运行）。 对 RRN 而言这是意料之中：在退火网络近似下，任意度数 K K 的 RRN 上的动力学都简化为 FC（附录 A1）。 这表明，在度数同质的网络中的挽救需要邻居状态之间的动力学相关性。

paragraphs.en: We embedded populations of LLM agents playing the minimal naming game in networks of controlled degree structure and measured how they converge on a convention and how easily a committed minority can overturn it. Three main results emerge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将扮演最小命名博弈的大语言模型智能体种群嵌入到度结构可控的网络中，测量它们如何收敛到一个约定，以及一个坚定的少数群体推翻该约定的难易程度。 出现了三个主要结果。

sents.en: We embedded populations of LLM agents playing the minimal naming game in networks of controlled degree structure and measured how they converge on a convention and how easily a committed minority can overturn it.
sents.zh: 我们将扮演最小命名博弈的大语言模型智能体种群嵌入到度结构可控的网络中，测量它们如何收敛到一个约定，以及一个坚定的少数群体推翻该约定的难易程度。

sents.en: Three main results emerge.
sents.zh: 出现了三个主要结果。

paragraphs.en: First, denser topologies support faster consensus: for most word pairs, convergence time is ordered FC < < UCM 2.5 < < UCM 5.0 < < RRN. Because they interact more often, hubs reach a given success level slightly earlier than low-degree nodes, consistent with classical naming game experiments in which agreement forms around hubs and spreads outward [ 32 ] . Persistent neighbourhoods matter mainly in the disordered phase, where low-degree nodes can settle local agreements with their few fixed partners, echoing the known tension between locally stabilising structure and global convergence [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] . These results parallel human systems, where topology is known to affect convergence [ 31 , 32 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，更密集的拓扑结构支持更快的共识：对于大多数词对，收敛时间的排序为 FC < < UCM 2.5 < < UCM 5.0 < < RRN。 由于中心节点互动更频繁，它们比低度节点稍早达到给定的成功水平，这与经典命名游戏实验一致，即共识围绕中心节点形成并向外扩散 [ 32 ] 。 持续的邻域关系主要在无序阶段起作用，此时低度节点可以与其少数固定伙伴达成局部一致，这印证了已知的局部结构稳定与全局收敛之间的张力 [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] 。 这些结果与人类系统中的情形类似，在人类系统中，拓扑结构已知会影响收敛 [ 31 , 32 , 18 ] 。

The rescue vanishes when neighbours are reshuffled, showing that dynamical correlations between persistent neighbours are necessary for it. Unlike density leading to faster consensus, these effects have not been observed in human populations.

paragraphs.en: Third, the critical fraction p ∗ p^{*} needed to overturn an established convention follows p ∗ ​ ( hub ) ≤ p ∗ ​ ( random ) ≤ p ∗ ​ ( low-degree nodes ) p^{*}(\text{hub})\leq p^{*}(\text{random})\leq p^{*}(\text{low-degree nodes}) in all conditions. The most cost-effective attack on a multi-agent LLM system is thus to target its hubs [ 43 , 44 ] , mirroring degree-targeted attacks [ 45 ] . Unlike prompt injection, jailbreaks, or manipulated knowledge propagating between agents [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] , this attack compromises neither the agents nor the content they exchange: it merely places ordinary, persistently opinionated agents at well-connected positions. For randomly placed committed minorities, the ordering RRN < < UCM 5.0 < < UCM 2.5 < < FC holds in only five of the eight model-direction combinations tested, highlighting variability across models. In the minimal naming game, the tipping point is known to shift with mean degree and connectivity [ 33 ] , and committed agents at central or highly active positions are far more effective than randomly placed ones [ 41 , 42 ] . We show that these effects persist, and sharpen, in LLMs.

paragraphs.en: Our work has limitations. First, results are model dependent: Llama departs from the majority pattern in speed ordering, in the topology dependence of p ∗ p^{*} , and in having mixed-state pairs, so more models are needed before generalising. Second, the minimal naming game makes collective properties testable at population sizes beyond the reach of direct LLM querying, but it is a simplified task; future work should test more ecological scenarios with richer interactions [ 49 , 50 , 51 ] . Third, we fixed memory at H = 5 H=5 and the number of competing conventions at W = 2 W=2 . Consensus in LLM populations depends on memory [ 34 ] , and larger convention sets open indirect routes between equilibria that change the cost of an attack [ 27 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作存在局限性。 首先，结果依赖于模型：Llama 在速度排序、p ∗ p^{*} 的拓扑依赖性以及出现混合状态对方面偏离了多数模式，因此在推广之前需要更多模型。 其次，最简命名博弈使得集体性质可以在超出直接查询大语言模型能力范围的群体规模上进行检验，但它是一个简化的任务；未来工作应测试具有更丰富交互的更多生态场景 [ 49 , 50 , 51 ] 。 第三，我们将记忆固定为 H = 5 H=5，将相互竞争的约定数量固定为 W = 2 W=2。 大语言模型群体中的共识依赖于记忆 [ 34 ] ，而更大的约定集合会在均衡之间开辟间接路径，从而改变攻击的成本 [ 27 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Despite these limitations, our results bear directly on the safety of multi-agent systems, where heterogeneous topologies are increasingly common [ 30 , 44 , 10 ] . In most of our settings, well-mixed populations reach consensus faster and require larger committed minorities to be overturned than networked ones, so well-mixed estimates can overstate robustness. In a few cases, topology even changes which convention is established and whether consensus is reached. Moreover, because all agents in a well-mixed population are equivalent, the effect of committed-agent placement cannot be observed there. This matters because the conventions agent populations adopt can have tangible consequences, from prices set by autonomous pricing agents [ 52 , 53 ] to narratives amplified by agent swarms [ 6 ] . The safety of multi-agent systems depends on these collective outcomes as much as on individual model behaviour [ 2 , 54 ] . As agents are increasingly deployed in networks, assessing their safety will require mapping who interacts with whom, alongside testing the agents themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些局限，我们的结果仍直接关系到多智能体系统的安全性，因为异构拓扑结构在其中日益普遍 [ 30 , 44 , 10 ] 。 在我们的大多数设置中，与网络化种群相比，均匀混合种群更快达成共识，且需要更大的坚定少数派才能被推翻，因此均匀混合的估计可能高估稳健性。 在少数情况下，拓扑结构甚至会改变最终确立哪种惯例以及能否达成共识。 此外，由于均匀混合种群中所有智能体都是等价的，坚定智能体的放置位置所产生的影响在那里无法被观察到。 这一点很重要，因为智能体种群所采纳的惯例可能产生切实的后果，从自主定价智能体设定的价格 [ 52 , 53 ] 到智能体集群放大的叙事 [ 6 ] 。 多智能体系统的安全性既取决于个体模型行为，也同样取决于这些集体结果 [ 2 , 54 ] 。 随着智能体越来越多地部署在网络中，评估其安全性将需要刻画谁与谁交互，同时也要测试智能体本身。

An annealed network is a network in which the edges are randomly rewired, at a rate much faster than the dynamics of the nodes, while keeping the degree of each node fixed. The annealed network approximation is interesting because, due to the edge rewiring, it renders exact the hypothesis of lack of dynamical correlations between the states of neighbouring nodes, which is an approximation in the quenched mean field theory. Thus, we expect that numerical simulations in annealed networks will be exactly described by the annealed network approximation, while in quenched networks we can have deviations from the theory, either QMF or the annealed network approximation, due to the presence of dynamical correlations. In any case, the annealed network approximation renders simplex equations that sometimes capture the scaling behaviour of the dynamics.
